name: Imouto no Omocha ni Sarete Shimau Boku
original_name: 妹のオモチャにされてしまう僕
source:
When my mother remarried, I got a new step-sister.
She's a cute girl in front of our parents.
But when we're alone, her attitude changes...

She insults me and steps on my crotch, she barges into my bath and makes me wash her,
she makes me relieve stress, and she tells me to lick her sweaty feet.
I can't resist my sister!

Before I knew it, I was engrossed in our naughty acts, and I had become her toy.
translation:
当我母亲再婚时，我有了一个新的继姐妹。
在我们父母面前她是一个可爱的女孩。
但当我们独处时，她的态度就会改变……

她侮辱我，踩我的胯部，她闯进我的浴缸，让我给她洗澡，
她让我缓解压力，她让我舔她出汗的脚。
我对姐姐毫无抵抗力！

不知不觉间，我就沉浸在我们的调皮行为中，成了她的玩具。
